components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: trust blue fill, white label, 12px radius.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:12px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, filter .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn--primary { background:var(--brand,#0038A8); color:#fff; border:1px solid var(--brand,#0038A8); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .18), 0 6px 16px rgb(0 56 168 / .2); } .ds-btn--primary:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn--primary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn--primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand,#0038A8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Supporting action: surface fill, hairline border, ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:12px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn--secondary { background:var(--surface,#FFFDFA); color:var(--ink,#1B2433); border:1px solid var(--line,#DDD8CE); } .ds-btn--secondary:hover { background:var(--surface-2,#F4EEE3); border-color:rgb(27 36 51 / .3); } .ds-btn--secondary:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn--secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand,#0038A8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Sun Button
components.description: Highlight CTA on navy bands: yellow fill with ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:12px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn--sun { background:var(--sun,#FCD116); color:#1B2433; border:1px solid #D9B600; box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgb(255 255 255 / .4); } .ds-btn--sun:hover { filter:brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn--sun:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn--sun:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #FCD116; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive or emergency action only: alert red fill.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:10px; min-height:48px; padding:0 20px; border-radius:12px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .15s ease, transform .1s ease; } .ds-btn--danger { background:var(--alert,#CE1126); color:#fff; border:1px solid var(--alert,#CE1126); } .ds-btn--danger:hover { filter:brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn--danger:active { transform:scale(.97); } .ds-btn--danger:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--alert,#CE1126); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Editable confirmed field: surface fill, hairline, 10px radius, 48px height.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field__label { font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--subtle,#586377); } .ds-field__input { min-height:48px; border:1px solid var(--line,#DDD8CE); border-radius:10px; padding:0 14px; font-family:inherit; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:var(--ink,#1B2433); background:var(--surface,#FFFDFA); box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / .06); outline:none; transition:border-color .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease; } .ds-field__input:focus { border-color:var(--brand,#0038A8); box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgb(0 56 168 / .2); }

components.name: Panel
components.description: The one primary working surface of a screen: 24px radius, lit paper ring.
components.html:
Mga detalye

Tingnan kung tama ang nabasa namin.
components.css: .ds-panel { background:var(--surface,#FFFDFA); border:1px solid var(--line,#DDD8CE); border-radius:24px; padding:20px; box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px rgb(255 255 255 / .85), 0 1px 2px rgb(16 24 40 / .05), 0 4px 12px rgb(16 24 40 / .05); font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#1B2433); } .ds-panel__title { margin:0 0 6px; font-family:Fraunces,Georgia,serif; font-size:1.5rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-panel__text { margin:0; color:var(--subtle,#586377); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A self-contained item: 16px radius, hairline, flat.
components.css: .ds-card { background:var(--surface,#FFFDFA); border:1px solid var(--line,#DDD8CE); border-radius:16px; padding:16px; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; color:var(--ink,#1B2433); } .ds-card strong { font-size:1.125rem; font-weight:700; } .ds-card p { margin:4px 0 0; color:var(--subtle,#586377); }

components.name: Suggestion Chip
components.description: A tappable suggestion: full pill, hairline, 48px target.
components.html: <button class="ds-chip">May bawas ba sa sahod ko?</button>
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:48px; padding:0 16px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid var(--line,#DDD8CE); background:var(--surface,#FFFDFA); color:var(--ink,#1B2433); font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s ease, border-color .15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background:var(--brand-soft,#E9F0FF); border-color:rgb(0 56 168 / .5); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--brand,#0038A8); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: A non-interactive status label: tinted pill with icon + text.
components.css: .ds-badge { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:2px 10px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--sun,#FCD116); color:#1B2433; font-family:Figtree,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700; }

components.description: Current section: blue-wash track, brand text, never color alone.

narrative.overview: Linaw is the warm, well-lit kitchen where a trusted kuya or ate spreads a contract on the table, points at the line that matters, and explains it in words you already know. The light is honest and clear; the room is familiar, not corporate. Paper, woven banig, and the eight-ray sun are the material memory. The interface never performs authority at the worker; it sits beside them. The system is mobile-first and low-bandwidth by instinct, with one obvious action per screen and full states for a stressed user on a cheap phone.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white paper, deep ink, flag blue for action, sun yellow as a fill, alert red only for worry.
Fraunces speaks; Figtree works. The serif is for the brand, page titles, and money; UI chrome stays sans.
Hairline-first depth: flat surfaces with one restrained shadow where something truly floats.
Rounded, touchable, 48px controls; 16px body floor; WCAG AA contrast.
The eight-ray sun and faint banig are seasoning, never wallpaper.

rules.name: The Sun Is a Fill Rule
rules.body: Yellow never appears as text on a light surface and never as a thin outline around light text. It is a fill with ink on top, or a small icon tile, or the sun.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Trust blue is spent on the single most important action, the active navigation state, and source links. It is not a decorative wash.

rules.name: The Red Means Worry Rule
rules.body: Alert red only appears where the worker should pause: a deduction, a penalty, a worse contract term, an unreadable photo, an emergency.

rules.name: The 16px Floor Rule
rules.body: No body, hint, input, or legal-term text ships below 16px. 14px is for labels and metadata only.

rules.name: The Serif in the Parlor Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is the voice at the table: brand, page titles, big money, and the landing's promise. It never sets buttons, form labels, table cells, or navigation.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: On a phone, the primary action sits in the lower half of the viewport or in a full-width control.

rules.name: The Single Panel Rule
rules.body: A working screen has one 24px primary panel at most. Everything else is a 16px card or a list group.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: At rest, a surface is flat with a 1px border. Reach for a shadow only when the surface actually overlaps or floats.

rules.name: The No Nested Card Rule
rules.body: A card inside a card inside a panel is always wrong. Use a list group, a divider, or a tonal section instead.

rules.name: The Banig Restraint Rule
rules.body: The woven pattern is used at low contrast in empty states, upload zones, and one divider at most. It never sits under body text.

dos: Do keep the paper ground, ink, and one clear primary action per screen.
Do use the sun as a fill with ink on top, or as the circular mark.
Do set body copy at 16px or larger and give every control a 48px tap target.
Do pair every worry signal with a word and an icon, never color alone.
Do cite the clause for every summary claim and show the formula for every peso.
Do keep the professional and legal disclaimer visible on summary, compare, and chat surfaces.
Do use Fraunces for brand, page titles, and big money; Figtree for everything functional.
Do test 390px and 1440px with real, long Taglish copy.
donts: Don't use yellow as text on a light surface or red as brand decoration.
Don't nest cards or put a colored side stripe on a callout.
Don't use gradient text, glass as decoration, or zero-offset colored halos.
Don't add an eyebrow/kicker above a heading; the heading carries itself.
Don't render model output as HTML without sanitization.
Don't let the LLM calculate or state a peso figure; calculators own money.
Don't present generated glossary definitions or unverified agency contacts as fact.
Don't ship a screen without its empty, loading, error, and offline states where the flow needs them.
